components.name: Button
components.description: The primary action control, with variants, sizes, icons, and a loading state.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner and disables interaction.

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Native button props. Defaults to type="button".

notes: Renders a native <button>; for navigation use Link instead.
While loading, the label is visually hidden but kept in the layout so the button never resizes.
Announces a busy state via aria-busy.

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.description: Groups related actions, optionally joined into one segmented control.

components.name: CopyButton
components.description: Copies a value to the clipboard and reports success to all users.
notes: Success is announced via a polite live region, so screen readers hear it too.

components.name: FloatButton
components.description: A fixed action button for global actions, with an optional label, badge, and back-to-top behavior.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon; defaults to an up arrow for backTop.

props.name: label / description
props.description: Optional text; a label turns the button into a pill.

props.name: backTop
props.description: Scroll to the top (or target) on press.

notes: Renders a real button with an accessible name from aria-label, the label, or the tooltip.
backTop uses smooth scrolling and respects prefers-reduced-motion through the browser setting.

components.name: IconButton
components.description: Icon-only button with a required accessible name.
notes: A meaningful aria-label is enforced by the type signature.

components.name: ToggleButton
components.description: A two-state button that exposes aria-pressed.
notes: Exposes its state with aria-pressed rather than aria-expanded.

components.name: ToggleGroup
components.description: Related toggles with roving tab order and arrow-key navigation.
notes: Arrow keys move between items; only the active item is tabbable (roving tabindex).
Each item renders as a button with aria-pressed.

components.name: ActivityFeed
components.description: Timestamped list of activity records with optional avatars, icons, and targets.

props.name: items
props.description: Records to render; each has action and timestamp plus optional actor/target/icon/avatar.

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Native list props; the root is a <ul>.

notes: Each item is a list row; item.avatar takes precedence over item.icon.
Provide a stable item.id when the list reorders so React reuses rows.

components.name: PageHeader
components.description: Page title, description, contextual breadcrumbs, and primary actions.

props.name: breadcrumbs
props.description: Contextual navigation such as a breadcrumb trail.

props.name: actions
props.description: Primary page actions, aligned to the end.

notes: Renders a semantic <header>; the title is an <h1> and should be unique per page.

components.name: PageShell
components.description: Consistent page structure with optional sidebar, header, toolbar, and footer.

props.name: sidebar
props.description: Persistent sidebar region beside the content.

props.name: header
props.description: Sticky top region, typically a Navbar or PageHeader.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: Sub-header toolbar region beneath the header.

props.name: footer
props.description: Region rendered below the main body.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Max content width; null fills the container.

notes: Provide either a sidebar or full-width content; the sidebar toggles the data-has-sidebar layout.
Regions are omitted entirely when their prop is null or undefined.

components.name: SettingsSection
components.description: Grouped block of settings rows with a title, description, and optional actions.

props.name: actions
props.description: Controls aligned to the end of the header.

notes: Companion SettingsRow renders a label/description with a trailing control.
SettingsRow.props: label (required), description, control, htmlFor, orientation ("horizontal" | "vertical").
Pass htmlFor to associate the row label with a form control id.

components.name: ThemeToggle
components.description: Cycles or selects the active theme through the ambient ThemeProvider.

props.name: variant
props.description: Icon cycles light/dark; segmented adds a system option.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Show the current theme name next to the icon.

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Native button props for the icon variant.

notes: Must be rendered within a ThemeProvider; it reads and writes through useTheme.
The icon variant announces the current and next theme via aria-label.

components.name: Toolbar
components.description: Groups actions and controls into consistent start, center, and end regions.

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Native div props; the root has role="toolbar".

notes: Sets role and aria-orientation so assistive tech announces it as a toolbar.

components.name: UserMenu
components.description: Account menu with an avatar trigger, identity header, and action list.

props.name: items
props.description: Actions; each may be a link, danger, or have a divider.

props.name: footer
props.description: Extra content pinned below the actions.

notes: Built on DropdownMenu, so placement and dismissal match the rest of the system.
Items with `href` render as anchors; others render as menu items with onSelect.

components.name: VersionBadge
components.description: Package/environment indicator such as v1.4.2 · staging.
notes: The environment segment is omitted when the prop is empty.

components.name: Attachment
components.description: A file card with a type icon or thumbnail, size, upload progress, and remove/download actions.

props.name: name
props.description: File name shown and used for the type icon.

props.name: thumbnail
props.description: Image URL replacing the type icon.

props.name: href
props.description: Turns the name into a download link.

notes: formatFileSize is exported for use in custom file lists.
The progress bar is role=progressbar with aria-valuenow, not a decorative div.

components.name: Avatar
components.description: User or entity avatar with image, initials fallback, and a status indicator.

props.name: name
props.description: Accessible name and source for the initials fallback.

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL; falls back to initials when absent or broken.

props.name: size
props.description: Token size or an explicit pixel size.

props.name: status
props.description: Optional status dot (neutral, success, warning, danger, info).

props.name: fallback
props.description: Custom content when there is no image.

notes: Renders with role="img" and an aria-label derived from name or alt.
For overlapping stacks use AvatarGroup, which adds an overflow counter.

components.name: Badge
components.description: Compact status or metadata label with an optional dot or icon.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon, hidden from assistive tech.

notes: Exposes variant and size as data attributes for styling hooks.
Use Tag instead when the label is removable.

components.name: Bar Chart
components.description: Grouped or stacked bar chart measured from a zero baseline.

props.name: series
props.description: One group of bars per series.

props.name: categories
props.description: X-axis labels; each category gets its own band.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name rendered as the SVG <title>.

props.name: stacked
props.description: Stack series per category instead of grouping them side by side.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: Drop the built-in ui-* classes; behaviour and ARIA stay.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Per-slot overrides: root, svg, grid, axis, axisLabel, bar, legend, legendItem, swatch, legendLabel.

notes: Bars always start at zero: negative inputs are clamped so the baseline stays honest.
Stacked mode uses running totals, so every category shares one bar width.

components.name: Bubble
components.description: A chat message bubble with an avatar, author name, timestamp, and delivery footer.

props.name: time / footer
props.description: Timestamp and delivery state or actions.

props.name: hideAvatar
props.description: Keep alignment without the avatar column.

notes: The content tail is flattened on the speaker's side via a smaller corner radius.
Primary bubbles use the fill token with the matching foreground, so contrast is preserved.

components.name: Carousel
components.description: Sliding viewport of slides with controls, page dots and keyboard/swipe navigation.

props.name: count
props.description: Number of slides the carousel holds.

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Called whenever the active slide moves.

props.name: slidesPerView
props.description: Slides visible at once; sizes the dots' pages.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Interval in ms; disabled by default and under reduced motion.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name; supplying one makes the root a region landmark.

props.name: showControls / showDots
props.description: Toggle the built-in controls and dots.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: Drop the built-in ui-* classes; behaviour and ARIA stay.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Per-slot overrides: root, viewport, track, slide, controls, prev, next, dots, dot, dotMark, live.

notes: Arrow keys scroll when focus is inside, Home/End jump to the ends, and pointer drags past 40px flip a slide.
Only the slides in view stay in the accessibility tree and tab order — off-screen slides are inert.
A polite status region announces “Slide n of m” as the active slide changes.
Autoplay pauses on hover/focus and never starts under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: DataTable
components.description: Production data table: date-correct sorting, optional pagination, selection, filtering, and states.

props.name: getRowId
props.description: Stable row key; defaults to the index.

props.name: pagination
props.description: Pagination mode; inferred as client when pageSize is set.

props.name: page / pageSize / pageSizeOptions / total
props.description: Pagination controls. total drives server page counts.

props.name: selectable / selectAllScope
props.description: Row selection; header toggles the page by default.

props.name: searchable / globalFilter
props.description: Global text filtering; provide globalFilterFn for custom matching.

props.name: loading / error / onRetry / emptyMessage
props.description: Loading, error (with retry), and empty states.

notes: Date sorting is calendar-correct: date-only strings compare in local calendar order and never shift zones.
Empty/null/invalid values sort last in both directions; sorting is stable and never mutates `data`.
Server mode renders the supplied slice as-is — sorting, filtering, and slicing belong to the consumer.
Selection defaults to the visible page; use selectAllScope="all" for client-side all-filtered selection.

components.name: DescriptionList
components.description: Label/value information pairs rendered as a semantic description list.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Stack term above description or place them side by side.

props.name: columns
props.description: Lay items out in a multi-column grid.

notes: Renders a real <dl> with <dt>/<dd> for each item.

components.name: Donut Chart
components.description: Ring chart with a centre metric and a legend that carries values and percentages.

props.name: data
props.description: `{ label, value, color? }` slices; zero and negative values are ignored.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name rendered as the SVG <title>.

props.name: size
props.description: Square pixel size of the ring.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Ring thickness as a fraction of the radius.

props.name: centerValue / centerLabel
props.description: Centre metric; the value defaults to the formatted total.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: Drop the built-in ui-* classes; behaviour and ARIA stay.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Per-slot overrides: root, svg, slice, center, centerValue, centerLabel, legend, legendItem, swatch, legendLabel, legendValue.

notes: Slices are filled arcs rather than thick strokes, so they scale without clipping.
A full circle renders as two nearly-closed arcs (359.999°) to avoid the SVG zero-arc edge case.
The legend repeats every value and percentage, giving the graphic a text equivalent.

components.name: Image
components.description: An image with a loading state, fallback, caption, and an accessible lightbox preview.

props.name: preview
props.description: Open a full-screen lightbox on click.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Rendered when the image fails to load.

notes: The lightbox reuses Modal, so Escape, focus handling, and the close button come for free.
The clickable frame is a real button with an accessible name derived from alt.
Loading is lazy by default; override the native loading prop as needed.

components.name: Item
components.description: A media + content + actions row for lists, menus, and cards.

props.name: Item.Content
props.description: Flexible column for title and description.

props.name: Item.Actions
props.description: Trailing actions, aligned to the end.

notes: Subcomponents read the root's classNames and unstyled config through context.
Item.Media clips images to a rounded square and centers icons.

components.name: Line / Area Chart
components.description: Multi-series line chart with an optional area fill, grid, axis labels and legend.

props.name: series
props.description: `{ name, data, color? }` entries; missing colours fall back to the --ui-chart-* tokens.

props.name: categories
props.description: X-axis labels, one per data point.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name rendered as the SVG <title>.

props.name: variant
props.description: Area fills beneath each line. `AreaChart` is the same component with the fill on.

props.name: height
props.description: ViewBox height; the SVG scales to the container width.

props.name: smooth
props.description: Catmull-Rom smoothing instead of straight segments.

props.name: showGrid / showDots / showLegend
props.description: Toggle grid lines, point markers and the legend.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Axis tick formatting; defaults to compact 1.2k style.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: Drop the built-in ui-* classes; the graphic and ARIA stay intact.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Per-slot overrides: root, svg, grid, axis, axisLabel, area, line, dot, legend, legendItem, swatch, legendLabel.

notes: Pure math over a fixed viewBox — no DOM measurement, so server and client markup match.
Series colours come from the --ui-chart-1…6 tokens and can be overridden per series.
The SVG is a single `role="img"` with a <title>; the legend carries the series names as text.

components.name: List
components.description: Vertical list with plain, bordered, or divided variants and rich list items.

props.name: List.Item interactive
props.description: Render the item as a pressed-state button.

notes: List.Item becomes a <button> with aria-pressed when interactive is true.
The leading slot is aria-hidden; keep meaningful content in the label.

components.name: MessageScroller
components.description: A chat transcript viewport that stays pinned to the newest message and offers a jump-to-latest button.

props.name: autoScroll
props.description: Pin to the bottom when content grows.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Distance from the bottom that counts as pinned.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no children.

notes: The viewport is role=log with aria-live=polite and is keyboard focusable for scrolling.
A MutationObserver keeps the view pinned only while the user is already at the bottom.
The ref exposes scrollToBottom, scrollToTop, and getViewport.

components.name: RelativeTime
components.description: A semantic <time> with a live relative label and absolute tooltip.

props.name: now
props.description: Fixed reference time; disables the internal timer.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for the relative and absolute text.

props.name: updateInterval
props.description: Recompute interval in ms; 0 disables it.

props.name: showTitle
props.description: Expose the absolute timestamp as a native tooltip.

notes: Renders dateTime and title from the same Date, so the relative and absolute values never drift.
Pass a fixed `now` in tests or SSR to keep output deterministic.
The label refreshes on an interval by default; set updateInterval={0} to opt out.

components.name: Sparkline
components.description: Minimal inline trend chart rendered as a single SVG path.

props.name: data
props.description: Series of values to plot, left to right.

props.name: area
props.description: Fill the area beneath the line.

props.name: smooth
props.description: Smooth the path with Catmull-Rom curves.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible description; omit to render decoratively.

notes: Without a label the sparkline is aria-hidden and role="presentation".
Scales vertically against the min/max of the data, always including zero.

components.name: StatCard
components.description: Metric tile with a label, value, trend, and supporting information.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text such as the comparison window.

props.name: trend
props.description: Directional delta with an icon; positive defaults to direction !== "down".

notes: The trend is color-coded via data-positive, independent of the direction.

components.name: Table
components.description: Semantic compound table with header, body, footer, caption, and cell alignment.

props.name: responsive
props.description: Wrap the table in a horizontally scrollable container.

props.name: stickyHeader
props.description: Keep the header visible while scrolling.

props.name: Table.Header / Body / Footer
props.description: Semantic thead, tbody, and tfoot sections.

props.name: Table.Row
props.description: Row with an optional selected state.

notes: Header cells render with scope="col" for screen readers.
Use DataTable when you need sorting, selection, or pagination.

components.name: Tag
components.description: A label or removable token with an optional icon.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon, hidden from assistive tech.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Called when the remove button is pressed.

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the remove button.

notes: The remove affordance is a real button with an aria-label, not a clickable icon.

components.name: Timeline
components.description: Chronological event list with a connector rail and status markers.
notes: Renders an ordered list (<ol>) so the sequence is conveyed semantically.

components.name: Alert
components.description: Inline semantic message with variants, an icon, and optional dismissal.

props.name: variant
props.description: Semantic tone. warning and danger use role="alert".

props.name: icon
props.description: Override the default icon; pass false to hide it.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when the dismiss button is pressed.

props.name: actions
props.description: Inline actions rendered below the message.

notes: Urgent variants (warning, danger) use role="alert"; the rest use role="status".
Color is always paired with an icon so meaning is never conveyed by color alone.

components.name: CircularProgress
components.description: Radial progress indicator rendered as an SVG ring, determinate or indeterminate.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the percentage inside the ring.

notes: `ProgressRing` is an alias of this component for metric-style displays.

components.name: EmptyState
components.description: Neutral empty-data presentation with an optional icon, copy, and actions.

props.name: icon
props.description: Illustration or icon shown above the title.

notes: The icon is marked aria-hidden; keep the title meaningful on its own.

components.name: InlineMessage
components.description: Compact single-line validation or feedback message with a status icon.

props.name: icon
props.description: Override the status icon; false hides it.

notes: Designed to sit directly beneath a form control; pair it with aria-describedby.

components.name: LoadingOverlay
components.description: Wraps content and overlays a spinner while a region is busy.

props.name: loading
props.description: Show the overlay and set aria-busy.

props.name: blur
props.description: Apply a backdrop blur behind the overlay.

notes: Content is kept in the DOM so layout stays stable while loading.
The overlay is a polite live region announcing the label.

components.name: Meter
components.description: A gauge for a value inside a known range, with automatic good/warning/bad tone.

props.name: low / high
props.description: Bounds of the acceptable range; drives the tone.

props.name: optimum
props.description: Preferred value; defaults to the middle of low/high.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label, also used as the accessible name.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the formatted value beside the label.

notes: Uses role="meter" with aria-valuemin/max/now, not role="progressbar".
Tone is derived from low/high/optimum; pass tone to override it.
Use Progress for task completion and Meter for a measurement inside a range.

components.name: Notification
components.description: Rich, stackable notifications with a title, description, actions, and placement.

props.name: notify
props.description: Adds a notification and returns its id.

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons or links under the description.

notes: The stack is portaled and aria-live=polite; danger notifications switch to role=alert.
Hovering or focusing a notification pauses its dismiss timer.
Use Toast for transient confirmations and Notification when actions or detail matter.

components.name: Progress
components.description: Linear progress bar with variants, sizes, and an indeterminate mode.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the percentage beside the label.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when no visible label is provided.

notes: When no label is given, pass aria-label so the progressbar is announced.

components.name: Result
components.description: A full-area outcome message for success, error, and not-found states.

props.name: status
props.description: success, info, warning, danger, neutral, 404, 403, or 500.

notes: Status tones reuse the success/info/warning/danger subtle tokens.
The container is role=status so the outcome is announced when it appears.

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: Loading placeholder for text, circles, and rectangles.

props.name: lines
props.description: Stacked lines for the text variant.

notes: Marked aria-hidden; announce loading state on the surrounding region instead.

components.name: Spinner
components.description: Compact, themable loading indicator with accessible labeling.

props.name: label
props.description: Visually hidden label announced to AT.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Hide the spinner from the a11y tree.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Stroke width in SVG user units.

notes: Set decorative when the loading state is already announced by a parent region.

components.name: StatusIndicator
components.description: A status dot with an accessible label; never relies on color alone.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label; falls back to the status name.

props.name: pulse
props.description: Animate the dot for in-progress states.

notes: The label is always present for assistive technology, even in dotOnly mode.

components.name: Toast
components.description: Transient notifications surfaced through a provider and useToast hook.

props.name: duration
props.description: Auto-dismiss delay in ms; 0 keeps it open.

notes: Wrap the app in <ToastProvider> and call useToast() to enqueue toasts.
The dismiss timer pauses while a toast is hovered or focused.
Toasts are rendered in a Portal with aria-live="polite".

components.name: Autocomplete
components.description: Free-text input with filtered suggestions; values need not match an option.

props.name: value / onChange
props.description: Free-text value; may not match any option.

props.name: onSelectOption
props.description: Fired only when a suggestion is picked.

props.name: allowCustom
props.description: Permit values outside the option list.

notes: Combobox commits only options; Autocomplete keeps arbitrary text.
Arrow keys, Home/End, Enter, and Escape follow the combobox keyboard model.

components.name: Calendar
components.description: Date grid with single or range selection, localization, and full keyboard navigation.

props.name: events
props.description: Dated events highlighted across the grid.

props.name: numberOfMonths
props.description: Months to display side by side.

notes: Arrow keys move days, PageUp/PageDown change months (hold Shift for years), Home/End jump to week edges.
Events span an inclusive start/end and are announced through each day's aria-label; a dot marks days with more than one.
Dates are calendar dates with no time zone shift; see the date utilities for the underlying model.

components.name: Cascader
components.description: Picks a path through nested options across drilled-in columns.

props.name: options
props.description: `{ value, label, disabled?, children? }` tree of levels.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onChange
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled selected path; `onChange` also receives the leaf option.

props.name: changeOnSelect
props.description: Commit parent rows too instead of only drilling into them.

props.name: expandTrigger
props.description: How a parent row opens its child column.

props.name: displayRender
props.description: Replace the default “A / B / C” trigger rendering.

props.name: clearable / placeholder / label / emptyMessage
props.description: Chrome and copy for the trigger and empty popup.

props.name: size / disabled / invalid / required / name / valueSeparator
props.description: Standard control surface; `name` submits the joined path through a hidden input.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: Drop the built-in ui-* classes; behaviour and ARIA stay.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Per-slot overrides: root, trigger, value, placeholder, path, clear, indicator, popup, menu, column, menuItem, menuItemLabel, expandIcon, empty.

notes: One column per level; every column is a `listbox` and the trigger stays focused with `aria-activedescendant` pointing at the highlighted row, so the widget is a single tab stop.
Arrow Right drills in, Arrow Left steps back a level, Arrow Up/Down and Home/End move the highlight, Enter commits or drills.
The trigger is a combobox (`role="combobox"`, aria-haspopup="listbox") inside a FloatingLayer, so outside click, Escape and focus return are handled for you.
Optional clear button and a hidden input for form submission, wired through useFieldControl inside a FormField.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Native checkbox with a custom indicator and indeterminate support.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary help text, wired via aria-describedby.

notes: The indeterminate flag is reflected on the DOM input property; it never submits a value.
Wrap a set of checkboxes in a Fieldset to group and disable them together.

components.name: ColorPicker
components.description: Swatch trigger with a popup for presets, a native picker, a hex field and alpha.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled colour; the callback receives the string in the chosen `format`.

props.name: format
props.description: Output format for the value, the trigger label and the callback. Hex gains an alpha byte when needed.

props.name: withAlpha
props.description: Add an opacity slider and let presets keep the current alpha.

props.name: swatches
props.description: Preset colours in the popup grid; defaults to a curated ten-swatch palette.

props.name: nativeInput
props.description: Show the OS colour input inside the popup.

props.name: showValue / placement / label
props.description: Value text in the trigger, popup placement and the accessible name of the trigger and dialog.

props.name: name / submitFormat
props.description: A hidden input submits the formatted value, or the opaque hex when asked.

props.name: size / invalid / disabled / id
props.description: Standard control surface; wires into FormField through useFieldControl.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: Drop the built-in ui-* classes; behaviour and ARIA stay.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Per-slot overrides: root, trigger, swatch, value, indicator, popup, section, label, native, hexInput, alpha, alphaInput, invalid, swatches, swatchButton.

notes: The popup is a FloatingLayer dialog: Escape, outside clicks, focus return and anchoring are handled for you.
The text field accepts anything the parser understands — hex (3, 4, 6 or 8 digits), rgb()/rgba() and hsl()/hsla() — and reports invalid input next to the field.
Presets show a readable tick, picked from the swatch's relative luminance.

components.name: Combobox
components.description: Searchable single-select combobox with a custom listbox, grouping, and descriptions.

props.name: options
props.description: Options with optional group, description, icon, and disabled.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Show a clear button when a value is set.

props.name: loading / error
props.description: Async and error states for the popup.

notes: Prefer Combobox over Select when search, grouping, or rich option content is required; Select stays natively backed for simple cases.
The text input is the ARIA combobox; the popup listbox is linked via aria-controls and aria-activedescendant.

components.name: DatePicker
components.description: Read-only date input that opens a popup Calendar.
notes: The trigger is read-only so the value is always a real calendar date, never free-typed text.

components.name: DateRangePicker
components.description: Two-month range calendar in a popup with hover preview.
notes: Clicking a day before the start restarts the range; hovering previews the pending range.

components.name: DateTimePicker
components.description: Date and time in a single control, combining the calendar with time columns.
notes: Values are local date-times (no timezone), so they cannot drift across zones.
Composes the shared Calendar, so range/keyboard behaviour is identical.

components.name: Editor
components.description: Rich-text editor with toolbar, placeholders, and serialization.
notes: Supports placeholders via {{key}} syntax.

components.name: Fieldset
components.description: Groups related controls with a legend and native disabled propagation.

props.name: legend
props.description: Group label; may be visually hidden.

props.name: description
props.description: Introductory text shown below the legend.

props.name: hideLegend
props.description: Keep the legend for screen readers only.

notes: A native <fieldset> propagates disabled to all descendants automatically.

components.name: FileUpload
components.description: Drag-and-drop file input with size limits and a removable file list.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Per-file byte limit; over-sized files are rejected.

notes: The dropzone is a labelled, keyboard-operable button (Enter/Space opens the picker).
A hidden native file input keeps form submission and `required` working.

components.name: Form
components.description: Form engine with values, touched state, sync/async validation, and submission.

props.name: useField / useController
props.description: Single-field read/write, with optional transform and field-level validation.

props.name: useWatch / useFormState / useFieldArray
props.description: Subscribe to a value or state slice, and manage repeater rows.

notes: FormField reads errors from the enclosing Form by name and only shows them once the field is touched or the form has been submitted.
Handlers accept either a change event or a plain value, so bind works with Input as well as Combobox/MultiSelect.

components.name: FormActions
components.description: Consistent layout for a form's submit and cancel controls.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Pin the actions to the bottom of a scroll container.

notes: Pairs with a FormField stack; place it as the final child of a <form>.

components.name: FormBuilder
components.description: Schema-driven form: describe fields once and let the builder render and wire them.

props.name: form
props.description: The engine that owns values and errors.

props.name: fields
props.description: Field schema (label, type, options, colSpan, hidden).

props.name: columns
props.description: Grid columns; collapses to one on narrow screens.

notes: Field types: text, email, password, number, date, time, textarea, select, checkbox, switch, and custom.
Use type: "custom" with a render function for anything the schema can't express.

components.name: FormBuilderV2
components.description: Visual form designer with groups, multi-column layout, and field inspector.
notes: Shares the generic builder framework with SurveyBuilder.

components.name: FormField
components.description: Wires a label, description, and error to a control through generated ids and context.

props.name: error
props.description: When set, marks the field invalid and announces the message.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the label and control required.

props.name: optional
props.description: Shows an optional hint on the label.

notes: Field state is shared via context, so Input, Select, and friends configure themselves automatically.
useFormField() reads the wiring; useRequiredFormField() throws when no field is present.

components.name: InlineEdit
components.description: Click-to-edit text with keyboard save/cancel and blur-to-commit.

props.name: submitOnBlur
props.description: Commit when focus leaves the field.

notes: Enter saves, Escape cancels, and blur saves by default; use submitOnBlur={false} to require an explicit save.
The trigger is a real button, so the value is reachable and editable from the keyboard.
The headless logic is exported as useInlineEdit for custom presentations.

components.name: Input
components.description: Text input that supports every native input type.
notes: Inside a FormField, id, aria-describedby, required, and disabled are inherited from the field.

components.name: InputGroup
components.description: Attaches addons and action buttons flush to an input.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Invalid styling for the whole group.

props.name: InputGroup.Button
props.description: An action button attached flush to the group.

notes: Compose any `.ui-control` between the addons and buttons; defaults to type="button" on actions.

components.name: InputMask
components.description: Text input that keeps its value in a fixed shape while typing.

props.name: mask
props.description: Pattern where `9` is a digit, `a` a letter, `*` alphanumeric and every other character is a literal (escape one with `\`).

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled masked value; the callback also receives the raw characters.

props.name: submitMasked / name
props.description: A hidden input submits the raw value by default, or the masked one when asked.

props.name: placeholder / placeholderChar
props.description: Placeholder text; defaults to the mask with underscores, e.g. `(___) ___-____`.

props.name: size / invalid / disabled / required / id
props.description: Standard control surface; wires into FormField through useFieldControl.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: Drop the built-in ui-* classes; behaviour and ARIA stay.

notes: Characters that do not match the current token are dropped, so the value can never be malformed.
Literals are committed only once the token after them is filled, so partial input stays readable.
A numeric-only mask switches the input to `inputMode="numeric"` for the right mobile keypad.
The root exposes `data-complete` once every mask position is filled.

components.name: InputOTP
components.description: Segmented one-time-password input with paste support and full keyboard navigation.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Fires once all segments are filled.

props.name: groupSize
props.description: Insert a visual gap after every N segments.

props.name: name
props.description: Adds a hidden input carrying the code.

notes: Pasting a code fills every segment; arrow, Home, and End keys move between cells.

components.name: Mentions
components.description: A textarea with @mention autocomplete, keyboard navigation, and a typed suggestion list.

props.name: options
props.description: Suggestions with value, label, description, and avatar.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Fires when a mention is inserted.

props.name: filterOption
props.description: Custom matching; defaults to label/value contains.

notes: Arrow keys move the active option; Enter or Tab inserts it and Escape dismisses the list.
The popup is a FloatingLayer, so it closes on outside interaction and is positioned for you.
Selecting inserts `@value ` and places the caret after the trailing space.

components.name: MultiSelect
components.description: Multi-selection control with chips, search, overflow handling, and a shared listbox.

props.name: maxSelected
props.description: Cap selections; further options become disabled.

props.name: maxVisibleChips
props.description: Collapse chips beyond this into a +N indicator.

notes: Backspace in an empty search removes the last chip; helper chips are announced with aria-selected on each option.
Shares keyboard and filtering logic with Combobox via the same listbox core so the two cannot drift.

components.name: NumberInput
components.description: Numeric input with validation, clamping, and optional stepper controls.

props.name: min / max
props.description: Bounds applied on blur and when stepping.

props.name: step
props.description: Increment used by the steppers and arrow keys.

notes: The empty string clears the value and reports null; out-of-range entries clamp on blur.

components.name: PasswordInput
components.description: Password field with an accessible show/hide toggle.

props.name: ...rest
props.description: All Input props; type is fixed to password.

notes: The toggle exposes its state via aria-pressed and keeps the input's form semantics.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.description: Groups a set of radios with a single shared selection.

props.name: label
props.description: Group label rendered above the radios.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every radio in the group.

props.name: Radio
props.type: value: string; label?: ReactNode; description?: ReactNode; size?: "sm" | "md"
props.description: A single option, wired to the group.

notes: The group provides name, selection state, and disabled propagation to each Radio via context.

components.name: Rating
components.description: Star rating on a native radio group, with hover preview and optional clearing.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled rating; `onValueChange(0)` fires when a cleared rating is emptied.

props.name: allowClear
props.description: Clicking the current value clears the rating.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Render a static `role="img"` value with an “n out of m” name.

props.name: icon / renderIcon
props.description: Replace the glyph; `renderIcon` receives `{ filled, index }`.

props.name: size / disabled / name / label
props.description: Star size, disabling, the shared radio name and the group's accessible label.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: Drop the built-in ui-* classes; behaviour and ARIA stay.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Per-slot overrides: root, item, input, icon.

notes: Each star is a native radio inside a radiogroup, so arrow keys, roving focus and form submission come from the platform.
Hovering previews the value; leaving the group restores the committed one.
A hidden input is not needed — pass `name` and the checked radio submits itself.

components.name: SearchInput
components.description: Text input with a leading search icon and a clear affordance.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Show the clear button when a value is present.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the clear button.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Fired when the clear button is pressed.

props.name: ...rest
props.description: All Input props; type is fixed to search.

notes: Works controlled or uncontrolled; the clear button appears only when the field is non-empty.

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.description: Single-select segmented buttons with radio semantics.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled selection; defaults to the first option.

props.name: size / disabled / name
props.description: Segment height, disabling, and the shared radio name for forms.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch the segments evenly across the container.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: Drop the built-in ui-* classes; behaviour and ARIA stay.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Per-slot overrides: root, item, input, icon, label.

notes: Every segment is a native radio, so arrow keys move the selection and the checked one submits with the form.
The active segment exposes `data-state="active"`; disabled segments drop out of the group without breaking arrow navigation.

components.name: Select
components.description: Accessible single-selection control backed by the native select element.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allow multiple selection; hides the chevron when set.

notes: Rendering a real <select> gives correct keyboard, mobile, and form-submission behavior for free.

components.name: Slider
components.description: Single-value range slider built on the native input[type=range].

props.name: showValue
props.description: Render the current value beside the track.

notes: The filled track is driven by a CSS custom property, so theming needs no JS layout work.

components.name: SurveyBuilder
components.description: Visual survey designer with palette, canvas, inspector, live preview, undo/redo.
notes: Ships a versioned JSON schema; renderer works independently.

components.name: Switch
components.description: Toggle switch built on a native checkbox with role=switch.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary help text, wired via aria-describedby.

notes: Keeps checkbox semantics while exposing role=switch for assistive technology.

components.name: Textarea
components.description: Multi-line text input with optional auto-resize and character count.

props.name: autoResize
props.description: Grow height to fit content up to maxRows.

notes: The character counter uses maxLength when provided; auto-resize respects the computed line height.

components.name: TimePicker
components.description: Hour/minute/second column picker with 12- or 24-hour cycles.
notes: Columns are independent listboxes; Up/Down move within a column and Tab moves between them.

components.name: Transfer
components.description: Dual list for moving many items between a source and a target set.

props.name: dataSource
props.description: `{ key, label, description?, disabled? }` rows shared by both panels.

props.name: targetKeys / defaultTargetKeys / onChange
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled right-hand keys; `onChange` receives the direction and the moved keys.

props.name: titles
props.description: Panel headings; each also labels its group.

props.name: showSearch / searchPlaceholder / filterOption
props.description: Per-side filter box; the default matches string labels case-insensitively.

props.name: listHeight / emptyMessage / label
props.description: List viewport height, empty copy and the group's accessible name.

props.name: disabled / renderItem
props.description: Disable every control, or replace the row label.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: Drop the built-in ui-* classes; behaviour and ARIA stay.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Per-slot overrides: root, panel, panelHeader, panelTitle, panelCount, selectAll, search, searchInput, list, item, itemBody, itemLabel, itemDescription, operations, moveRight, moveLeft, empty.

notes: Each panel keeps its own selection and search, with a select-all box that reports the indeterminate state.
Rows are real checkboxes, so Space toggles them and disabled rows can never move.
The move buttons disable themselves until a movable row is checked; oneWay hides the return button entirely.
onChange reports (targetKeys, direction, movedKeys) so the parent can keep its own model in sync.

components.name: TreeSelect
components.description: Selects one node from a tree in a floating, searchable popup.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Add a filter box; ancestors of matches stay visible.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Show a clear button when a value is set.

props.name: showPathInTrigger
props.description: Render the ancestry above the selected label.

props.name: expandSelectedPath
props.description: Open the branches leading to the current value.

props.name: allowParentSelect
props.description: Set false to only allow leaf selection.

props.name: size / disabled / invalid / required / name
props.description: Standard control surface, including a hidden input for forms.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: Drop the built-in ui-* classes; behaviour and ARIA stay.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Per-slot overrides: root, trigger, value, placeholder, path, clear, indicator, popup, search, searchInput, tree, empty.

notes: The trigger is a select-only combobox (`role="combobox"`, aria-haspopup="tree") while the popup keeps the tree's own roving-focus model.
Escape closes the popup and returns focus to the trigger; Tab closes it and moves on.
Filtering prunes to the branches containing a match and expands them automatically.
Inside a FormField it picks up id, description and error wiring via useFieldControl, exactly like the other controls.

components.name: Icon
components.description: Sized, colour-inheriting wrapper around a curated Lucide icon registry.

props.name: size
props.description: Named step from the control scale, or an explicit pixel size.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name; omit to mark the icon as decorative.

notes: Icons inherit colour from their parent, so they pick up button and link states automatically.
The registry is a curated, tree-shakeable subset — import more from lucide-react as needed.
Set label when the icon is the only content; otherwise it renders aria-hidden.

components.name: Icon in context
components.description: Icons aligned inside buttons and other controls.
notes: Prefer the component's startIcon/endIcon slots so spacing and sizing stay consistent.

components.name: Affix
components.description: Pins content to the top of the viewport or a scroll container after it scrolls past.

props.name: offsetTop
props.description: Distance from the top at which content sticks.

props.name: offsetBottom
props.description: Stop sticking this far from the viewport bottom.

props.name: target
props.description: Scroll container; defaults to the window.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires when the pinned state changes.

props.name: unstyled / classNames
props.description: Drop built-in classes or target the root/content slots.

notes: A placeholder keeps the original layout height, so nothing jumps when the content becomes fixed.
Pass target when the component scrolls inside a panel instead of the page.

components.name: AspectRatio
components.description: Constrains its children to a fixed aspect ratio using the native CSS aspect-ratio property.

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Native div props, including style and className.

notes: Uses the native CSS aspect-ratio property — no padding-hack wrapper is needed.
Let the child fill the box (e.g. width/height 100%) so it is measured against the ratio.

components.name: Box
components.description: The foundational polymorphic layout element: token padding on any intrinsic element via as.

props.name: as
props.description: Element or component the box renders as.

props.name: padding
props.description: Semantic padding step or raw CSS length.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class names merged onto the element.

props.name: ...rest
props.description: All props of the selected element are forwarded.

notes: Polymorphic: `as="a"` accepts `href`, `as="img"` accepts `src`, and so on.
Refs are forwarded to the underlying element.

components.name: Card
components.description: Compound container that groups related content into header, body, and footer sections.

props.name: padding
props.description: Internal padding for the root; sections manage their own.

notes: Sub-components are available both as static members (`Card.Header`) and named exports (`CardHeader`).
`Card.Title` renders an `h3` by default; change the level with its `as` prop.

components.name: Container
components.description: Centers content and constrains it to a readable max width with responsive gutters.
notes: Polymorphic via `as`; defaults to a centered `<div>`.

components.name: Divider
components.description: A horizontal or vertical separator that can carry a centered label.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Remove the divider from the a11y tree.

notes: Without a label it is exposed to assistive tech as a semantic `separator` with orientation.
Set `decorative` for purely visual rules so they are hidden from screen readers.

components.name: Flex
components.description: General-purpose flexbox container with direction, gap, alignment, wrap, and inline options.
notes: Sibling utilities `Inline`, `Center`, and `Spacer` are also exported from the layout package.

components.name: Grid
components.description: Responsive CSS grid with a fixed or auto-fit column count and token-driven gaps.

props.name: columns
props.description: Fixed column count or a template-columns value.

props.name: minItemWidth
props.description: Generate an auto-fit grid with items at least this wide.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap used when row/column gaps are not set.

notes: When `minItemWidth` is set it takes precedence over `columns`, producing `repeat(auto-fit, minmax(...))`.
`align` maps to `align-items` and `justify` to `justify-items`.

components.name: Masonry
components.description: A CSS multi-column masonry layout that preserves each item's natural height.

props.name: columnWidth
props.description: Responsive mode: minimum column width in px.

props.name: unstyled / classNames
props.description: Target the root or item slots.

notes: Layout is pure CSS columns, so there is no measurement or reflow loop.
Items use break-inside: avoid so cards are never split across columns.

components.name: ScrollArea
components.description: A styled scrolling container that themes the native scrollbar without custom scroll logic.

props.name: hideScrollbar
props.description: Hide the scrollbar visually but keep scrolling.

notes: Scrolling and keyboard behaviour are native; only the scrollbar appearance is themed.
Avoid `hideScrollbar` unless the content remains obviously scrollable another way.

components.name: SplitPane
components.description: Two resizable panes with a draggable, keyboard-operable separator.

props.name: onSizeChange
props.description: Fires while dragging or resizing by keyboard.

props.name: min / max
props.description: Clamp range for the first pane.

props.name: step
props.description: Keyboard resize step in percentage points.

notes: The separator is a focusable role="separator" with aria-valuemin/max/now.
Arrow keys resize, Home/End jump to min/max, and horizontal resizing respects RTL.
Pointer drag uses pointer capture, so the handle keeps tracking outside the element.
The headless behavior is exported as useSplitPane.

components.name: Stack
components.description: One-dimensional layout primitive with token-driven gaps and alignment along a single axis.
notes: Renders a flex container; use `direction="row"` for a horizontal stack.

components.name: Surface
components.description: A semantic surface with tone, border, radius, elevation, and padding.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Adds hover affordance for clickable surfaces.

notes: The lower-level primitive behind Card; use it for custom panels and containers.

components.name: VisuallyHidden
components.description: Hides content visually while keeping it available to assistive technology.

props.name: focusable
props.description: Reveal the content when it receives focus (skip links).

notes: Uses the standard clip technique — never `display: none` — so content stays in the a11y tree.
Ideal for icon labels and skip links; pair `focusable` with a visible focus style.

components.name: Watermark
components.description: Repeating text or image watermark rendered as a theme-aware SVG pattern.

props.name: image
props.description: Repeated image URL; takes precedence over text.

props.name: color
props.description: CSS colour; defaults to the muted token.

notes: The pattern is inline SVG, so it inherits currentColor and stays crisp when zoomed.
The layer is pointer-events: none, so content underneath stays interactive.

components.name: Accordion
components.description: Stacked disclosure panels that expand a single section or many at once.

props.name: type
props.description: Whether one or many panels can be open.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially open item value(s) when uncontrolled.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Allow closing the open item in single mode.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable every trigger in the group.

props.name: Accordion.Trigger indicator
props.description: Custom indicator; defaults to a chevron.

props.name: Accordion.Content forceMount
props.description: Keep the panel mounted while closed.

notes: Arrow keys, Home, and End move focus between triggers.
Triggers expose aria-expanded and wire aria-controls to their panel.
Panels unmount when closed unless forceMount is set.

components.name: Anchor
components.description: A table-of-contents anchor that scroll-spies sections and scrolls smoothly to them.

props.name: items
props.description: Sections with id, title, href, and optional children.

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: Fires when the observed section changes.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Pin the nav while the page scrolls.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the nav landmark.

notes: The active section is tracked with an IntersectionObserver; the active link gets aria-current=location.
Clicking a link scrolls with the configured offset and updates the URL hash.
Nested items render as a nested list for sub-sections.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.description: Hierarchical page trail that shows the user's location and links back up.

props.name: items
props.description: Ordered trail from root to current page.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the nav landmark.

props.name: maxItems
props.description: Collapse middle items when the trail exceeds this length.

props.name: separator
props.description: Custom separator; defaults to a chevron icon.

props.name: item.href
props.description: Renders the item as a link; omit for the current page.

props.name: item.icon
props.description: Optional icon rendered before the label.

notes: Renders a <nav> landmark wrapping an ordered list.
The final item is marked with aria-current="page" and rendered as text.
When maxItems is set, middle items collapse into an aria-hidden ellipsis.

components.name: Collapsible
components.description: Single disclosure panel with a trigger that expands one section of content.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called whenever the panel opens or closes.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: Drop the built-in ui-* classes; behaviour and ARIA stay.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Per-slot class overrides (root, trigger, indicator, content, contentInner).

props.name: Collapsible.Trigger indicator
props.description: Custom indicator; defaults to a chevron.

props.name: Collapsible.Content forceMount
props.description: Keep the panel mounted while closed.

notes: Trigger exposes aria-expanded and wires aria-controls; the panel is a labelled region.
Controlled and uncontrolled usage behave identically.
Set unstyled to keep only behaviour + aria wiring, or reach for the useCollapsible hook for fully custom markup.
classNames targets individual slots without a new stylesheet.

components.name: Navbar
components.description: Responsive top bar that collapses into a toggleable menu on small screens.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Pin the bar to the top of the viewport.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled mobile menu state.

props.name: Navbar.Link active
props.description: Marks the current page with aria-current.

notes: The nav and toggle button are only rendered inline above 48rem; below that the menu collapses.
The toggle automatically swaps between the menu and close icons and manages aria-expanded.
Place actions last so they push to the trailing edge.

components.name: Pagination
components.description: Page navigation with sibling windowing, edge controls, and optional jump-to-page.

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Called with the next page when it changes.

props.name: siblingCount
props.description: Pages shown around the current page.

props.name: showEdges
props.description: Show first and last page buttons.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the nav landmark.

notes: The active page is marked with aria-current="page".
getPageTokens windows the range with ellipses on either side.
Edge and jump controls reuse IconButton for consistent sizing.

components.name: Sidebar
components.description: Collapsible navigation rail that becomes an off-canvas drawer on mobile.

props.name: side
props.description: Which edge the rail sticks to.

props.name: Sidebar.Link icon
props.description: Leading icon, shown alone when collapsed.

notes: Above 48rem the sidebar is a persistent rail; below it slides in as a drawer with a backdrop.
Clicking the backdrop or Sidebar.Close dismisses the mobile drawer.
The toggle rotates and its pressed state reflects the collapsed flag.

components.name: Stepper
components.description: Progress indicator that tracks the active step in a multi-step workflow.

props.name: steps
props.description: Ordered list of steps with label and optional description.

props.name: current
props.description: Zero-based index of the active step.

props.name: clickable
props.description: Render each step as a button that can be selected.

props.name: onStepClick
props.description: Called with the step index when clickable and pressed.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the nav landmark.

notes: Completed steps render a check icon in place of their number.
The active step is marked with aria-current="step".
Set clickable to let users jump between non-disabled steps.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Compound tabs with roving tab order, keyboard navigation, and ARIA wiring.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected tab value when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the selected tab changes.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Arrow-key axis for the tab list.

props.name: activationMode
props.description: Whether focusing a tab selects it.

props.name: Tabs.Trigger value
props.description: Value linking a trigger to its panel.

props.name: Tabs.Content value
props.description: Value linking a panel to its trigger.

notes: Only the active trigger is tabbable (roving tabindex).
Arrow keys, Home, and End move focus; automatic mode selects on focus.
Triggers and panels are wired with aria-controls and aria-labelledby.

components.name: TreeView
components.description: Hierarchical tree with expand/collapse, roving focus and cascading multi-select.

props.name: items
props.description: Nodes with key, label, children, description and disabled.

props.name: defaultExpandAll
props.description: Expand every parent on first render.

props.name: cascade
props.description: Multiple mode: checking a node drives its leaf descendants.

props.name: defaultFocusedKey
props.description: Row that owns the tree's tab stop.

props.name: renderIcon / renderLabel
props.description: Custom leading visual and label per row.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: Drop the built-in ui-* classes; behaviour and ARIA stay.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Per-slot overrides: root, item, row, toggle, toggleIcon, checkbox, label, description, empty.

notes: Rows are flat `treeitem`s carrying aria-level, which screen readers handle more predictably than nested lists.
Arrow Up/Down walk the visible rows, Right expands or steps in, Left collapses or steps out, Home/End jump, Enter/Space select.
Multiple mode renders aria-checked with a derived mixed state for partially checked branches.
Everything token-driven: swap --ui-tree-indent, --ui-tree-row-* and --ui-tree-guide-color to reshape it.

components.name: AlertDialog
components.description: A modal confirmation for destructive or irreversible actions.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional icon shown above the title.

props.name: footer
props.description: Action row, typically the cancel/confirm buttons.

notes: Uses role="alertdialog" and disables backdrop dismissal, so a response is required.
No corner close button is rendered; provide explicit actions in the footer.

components.name: CommandPalette
components.description: Filterable command list with keyboard navigation and grouped results.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called on Escape, backdrop click, or selection.

props.name: footer
props.description: Pinned hint row at the bottom.

notes: Filtering matches any token against label, description, group, and keywords.
Locks scroll, traps focus, and restores it on close; wire the hotkey yourself.

components.name: ContextMenu
components.description: Right-click menu positioned at the pointer.

props.name: ContextMenu.Trigger
props.description: Single element that opens the menu.

props.name: ContextMenu.Content
props.description: The menu surface; positions at the pointer.

notes: Closes on outside pointer-down, scroll, or Escape, and restores arrow-key navigation.
Uses the same visual language as DropdownMenu.

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.description: A compound contextual menu anchored to a trigger element.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state on the root.

props.name: matchTriggerWidth
props.description: Align content width to the trigger.

props.name: DropdownMenu.Item onSelect
props.description: Called when an item is chosen.

notes: DropdownMenu.Content is portalled and closes on Escape or outside interaction.
Trigger, Content, Item, Separator, and Label compose as dropdownMenu.* compound parts.

components.name: HoverCard
components.description: Rich preview card revealed on hover or focus of its trigger.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the card opens or closes.

props.name: openDelay
props.description: Hover/focus delay before opening, in milliseconds.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: Grace period before closing, in milliseconds.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: Drop the built-in ui-* classes; hover/focus behaviour and ARIA stay.

props.name: HoverCard.Content arrow
props.description: Render a pointer aimed at the trigger.

notes: Opens after openDelay on hover or focus, and keeps open while the pointer travels into the card.
Wrap a focusable child (link, button) so keyboard users can reach it; Escape dismisses.
The card is a dialog labelled by the trigger, so screen readers announce whose preview it is.
Set unstyled for behaviour only, or use the useHoverCard hook to own the markup entirely.

components.name: MenuBar
components.description: Desktop-style menu bar: a row of dropdown menus with arrow-key traversal.
notes: Left/Right arrows move between menus while one is open; hover switches menus.
Composed on DropdownMenu, so positioning and dismissal are shared.

components.name: Modal
components.description: A dialog rendered with the native <dialog> element, in five sizes.

props.name: closeOnOverlayClick
props.description: Dismiss when the backdrop is clicked.

notes: Built on <dialog> with showModal(), so focus trapping and the top layer come from the platform.
Compose Trigger, Content, Header, Title, Description, Body, Footer, and Close.

components.name: NavigationMenu
components.description: Horizontal navigation with hover/click panels, one open at a time.

props.name: NavigationMenu.Trigger value
props.description: Links a trigger to its content.

props.name: NavigationMenu.Content value
props.description: Panel shown while its value is open.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: Grace period before closing on pointer leave.

notes: Left/Right arrows move between triggers; Escape closes the open panel.
Use NavigationMenu.Link for the panel's destinations.

components.name: Popconfirm
components.description: A compact confirmation popover anchored to its trigger, for destructive or irreversible actions.

props.name: onConfirm / onCancel
props.description: Fired by the action buttons or dismissal.

notes: The popup is role=alertdialog labelled by the title, so the question is announced.
Focus moves into the popup and returns to the trigger on dismissal.
Use AlertDialog when the confirmation needs a full modal.

components.name: Popover
components.description: A non-modal floating panel anchored to a trigger, for rich content.

props.name: matchTriggerWidth
props.description: Align content width to the trigger.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Move focus into the popover on open.

notes: Non-modal: focus is not trapped and the page stays interactive behind it.
Closes on Escape, returning focus to the trigger.

components.name: Sheet
components.description: A panel that slides in from any edge of the viewport.

props.name: size
props.description: Panel span along its slide axis.

props.name: closeOnOverlayClick
props.description: Dismiss when the backdrop is clicked.

notes: Traps focus, locks background scroll, and closes on Escape while open.
Compose Trigger, Content, Header, Title, Description, Body, Footer, and Close.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: A short label that appears on hover or focus of a single trigger.

props.name: children
props.description: A single trigger element that receives the wiring.

props.name: delay
props.description: Hover delay before showing, in milliseconds.

notes: Visibility is managed internally: opens on hover after delay and immediately on focus.
Escape dismisses it; the bubble is linked to the trigger via aria-describedby.

components.name: Tour
components.description: A guided product tour that spotlights targets and steps through contextual cards.

props.name: onFinish / onClose
props.description: Called when the last step finishes or the tour is dismissed.

props.name: mask / maskClosable
props.description: Dim the page and optionally close on mask click.

props.name: scrollIntoView
props.description: Scroll each target into view when its step opens.

notes: Targets can be a CSS selector, an element, or a resolver function; missing targets center the card.
The spotlight is a box-shadow cutout, so the page is dimmed without extra overlay layers.
The card is role=dialog, receives focus on each step, and Escape closes the tour.

components.name: Blockquote
components.description: Styled quotation with an optional attribution, wrapped in a figure.

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Native blockquote attributes forwarded to the element.

notes: The quote and attribution are grouped in a <figure>/<figcaption> pair for correct semantics.

components.name: Code
components.description: Inline code token with a subtle background, rendering a native code element.
notes: Use CodeBlock for multi-line, copyable samples.

components.name: CodeBlock
components.description: Formatted, copyable code with an optional filename header, line numbers, and wrapping.

props.name: code
props.description: Raw code. Falls back to string children when omitted.

props.name: language
props.description: Language label shown in the header.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Wrap long lines instead of scrolling.

notes: Copy success is announced through a polite live region, so screen readers hear it too.

components.name: Heading
components.description: Semantic heading whose visual scale is decoupled from its accessibility level.

props.name: as
props.description: Override the rendered element without changing the a11y level.

notes: Set level for document structure and size for appearance; the two are intentionally separate.

components.name: Kbd
components.description: A keyboard key or shortcut combination.

props.name: keys
props.description: Renders a key combination; joins keys with a visual +.

notes: Renders a semantic <kbd> element, so shortcuts are announced correctly.
The combination gets an aria-label (for example "Ctrl + K") while the visual plus is hidden from assistive tech.

components.name: Label
components.description: Accessible form label with required, optional, disabled, and hint affordances.

props.name: optional
props.description: Shows an "(optional)" hint when not required.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the label to match a disabled control.

notes: A native label cannot be required; the state is conveyed visually and to assistive tech.

components.name: Link
components.description: Accessible anchor with visual variants and automatic external-link handling.

props.name: external
props.description: Force external handling (target/rel and an indicator icon).

props.name: hideExternalIcon
props.description: Keep external behavior but hide the icon.

notes: Cross-origin absolute hrefs are detected as external on the client; set external explicitly for SSR.

components.name: Text
components.description: Polymorphic text primitive with size, tone, weight, alignment, and leading options.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render; defaults to a span.

notes: Defaults to a <span>; pass as to render a p, div, or other element while keeping the styles.

components.name: Truncate
components.description: Clamps text to one or more lines with an ellipsis.

props.name: lines
props.description: Visible lines before clamping; 1 renders a single-line ellipsis.

notes: Multi-line clamping uses -webkit-line-clamp; the single-line variant uses text-overflow ellipsis.
